title: Headline KOSPI rebound can coexist with a weak underlying breadth/regime after a concentrated AI unwind

news_contract.note: Counts are copied only from measurable repository issue-digest fields; no inferred counts.

confirmed: Repository issue-digest at 14:09 KST shows PARTIAL collection with 20 sources checked, 203 raw items and 195 deduplicated items.
Fresh external reporting on 2026-09-30 says KOSPI erased early gains later in the session while foreign investors were net sellers; elevated bond yields remained a pressure.

Financial Times reported KOSPI was down 18.8% in Q3 while still up strongly year-to-date, with memory-chip unwind a major contributor; this is secondary-source evidence, not an official causal attribution.
The repository already tracks the rates/energy issue GN-efbbbb703f594df7, whose market reaction remains PENDING.
hypothesis: After an extreme AI/memory-led concentration unwind, a headline KOSPI rebound led by Samsung Electronics/SK Hynix can overstate broad risk appetite. The more useful regime signal may be whether index recovery is confirmed by breadth, equal-weight performance and foreign-flow persistence. If cap-weighted KOSPI rises while breadth/equal-weight and foreign flows remain weak, treat the move as concentration resilience rather than broad risk-on.
unknown: Official full-session breadth and final foreign/institutional flow for 2026-09-30 at this run cutoff.
How much of the Q3 decline is causally attributable to AI-memory de-rating versus rates, oil, domestic policy and positioning.
Whether this divergence has predictive power for 1/3/5-day returns.
why_important: Prevents the model from translating large-cap semiconductor rebounds directly into whole-market risk-on signals after a concentrated drawdown.
counter_scenario: If final breadth, equal-weight KOSPI and foreign flows all improve with the cap-weighted index, the concentration-resilience interpretation weakens and the move is more consistent with broad risk-on.

handoffs.AI-C: Test cap-weighted KOSPI minus equal-weight/breadth divergence after top-decile semiconductor drawdowns; measure 1/3/5-day forward returns and control for US yields, SOX, USD/KRW and oil.
handoffs.AI-B: Falsify with mechanical index concentration, buyback/dividend flows, quarter-end rebalancing, and the possibility that breadth catches up later in the session.

provenance.claim_scope: Q3 KOSPI drawdown and memory-chip unwind context
